title: Uploaded lectures not processing
alert: transcoder queue backlog 3,412 videos; consumer lag 3 hours
root cause: One corrupt upload kept failing and blocked the queue because it retried forever
fix: Moved the corrupt file to a dead-letter queue and set a max retry count of 5

title: Gradebook not saving marks
alert: grades-db lock wait timeout; teachers unable to save marks after the Sunday mock test
root cause: A heavy analytics report ran on the primary grades database
fix: Killed the report and moved analytics to the read replica

title: Results portal down on results day
alert: results-api 502; database read replica lag 90s at 40x normal traffic
root cause: Every results page hit the database and replicas fell behind
failed fixes: Adding more results-api pods (increased database load)
fix: Served results from pre-generated static pages on the CDN behind a waiting room

title: Exam answers not saving
alert: exam-service autosave 409 session not found during mid-term exams; redis-exam used_memory 99%
root cause: The Redis session store ran out of memory and evicted live exam sessions
fix: Extended the exam window, raised redis-exam maxmemory, moved sessions to the dedicated Redis and replayed the autosave journal

title: Assignment uploads rejected
alert: assignments-api 413 Payload Too Large for PDF submissions; learner learner.priya@yahoo.com
root cause: An API gateway change lowered the upload limit from 50 MB to 1 MB
fix: Restored the 50 MB upload limit in the gateway and extended the deadline

title: Login OTPs delayed

fix: Moved OTPs to a dedicated transactional SMS route with email OTP as fallback
